shared_elements: arms/hands indicated on the front or sides of the body
central hanging/vertical motif below the waist
justification: The strongest correspondence is an upright anthropomorphic scheme with a belt-like horizontal band and a central hanging or vertical motif below it, with arms/hands associated with the torso. The biggest difference is that B is crowded with many distinct animal figures arranged in registers, while A is dominated by a single human-like body with far fewer subsidiary motifs.
